title: Onye Na-ewu Ihe Mgbochi
intro: N'ala sara mbara, otu onye dị ike malitere njem dị iche iche, nye ikike na ihe ndị dị mkpa. Mkpụrụ obi a zutere obodo dị iche iche ma chee ihe ịma aka pụrụ iche ihu, na-ahapụ akara na-adịgide adịgide n'akụkọ ihe mere eme na okwukwe site n'omume na amamihe ha, ha niile na-egosipụtakwa ebe ike ha si dị.
clues: E nyere m ike na ikike n'ihe niile, m wee soro ụzọ.
Njem m kpọgara m ebe anyanwụ na-ada, ebe m hụrụ otu ndị mmadụ.
Ezutere m otu obodo nke na-anaghị aghọta okwu nke ọma, bi n'etiti ugwu abụọ.
A gwara m ka m wuo ihe mgbochi, ọ bụghị maka uru onwe onye, ​​kama iji chebe onwe m pụọ n'ike mbibi.
Ekwupụtara m na ike iwu nnukwu mgbidi a sitere n'aka Allah, ọ ga-adịgidekwa ruo oge e kwere nkwa.
Aha m, nke a na-asụgharịkarị dị ka 'Onye nwere mpi abụọ,' na-egosi ike m ruru n'ụwa niile ma ọ bụ ikekwe oge abụọ dị iche iche.

arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
verse: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam. (18:95)
